005package org.wpilib.tunable;
006
007/** The base class for tunables. */
008@SuppressWarnings("PMD.AbstractClassWithoutAbstractMethod")
009public abstract class TunableBase {
010  private final TunableConfig m_config;
011  private final boolean m_supportsChangeNotification;
012
013  /**
014   * Whether the tunable value has changed since the last time it was tuned. This is set to true
015   * when set() is called and cleared when notifyTune() is called.
016   */
017  protected boolean m_changed;
018
019  /**
020   * Constructs a tunable base.
021   *
022   * @param config tunable config
023   */
024  protected TunableBase(TunableConfig config) {
025    this(config, false);
026  }
027
028  /**
029   * Constructs a tunable base.
030   *
031   * <p>If supportsChangeNotification is true, subclasses must call {@link #markChanged()} instead
032   * of setting m_changed directly.
033   *
034   * @param config tunable config
035   * @param supportsChangeNotification whether the tunable notifies backends when it changes
036   */
037  protected TunableBase(TunableConfig config, boolean supportsChangeNotification) {
038    m_config = config;
039    m_supportsChangeNotification = supportsChangeNotification;
040  }
041
042  /**
043   * Returns whether this tunable is robust.
044   *
045   * @see TunableConfig#isRobust()
046   * @return true if the tunable is robust, false otherwise
047   */
048  public boolean isRobust() {
049    return m_config != null && m_config.isRobust();
050  }
051
052  /**
053   * Returns the properties of this tunable as a JSON string.
054   *
055   * @see TunableConfig#getProperties()
056   * @return the properties of this tunable as a JSON string
057   */
058  public String getProperties() {
059    return m_config == null ? "{}" : m_config.getProperties();
060  }
061
062  /**
063   * Returns the configuration of this tunable.
064   *
065   * @return the configuration of this tunable
066   */
067  public TunableConfig getConfig() {
068    return m_config;
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * Returns whether the tunable value has changed since the last time it was tuned.
073   *
074   * @return true if the tunable value has changed, false otherwise
075   */
076  public boolean hasChanged() {
077    return m_changed;
078  }
079
080  /**
081   * Returns whether this tunable notifies backends when set() marks it changed.
082   *
083   * @return true if this tunable notifies backends when changed, false otherwise
084   */
085  public boolean supportsChangeNotification() {
086    return m_supportsChangeNotification;
087  }
088
089  /** Marks the tunable changed and notifies backends. */
090  protected void markChanged() {
091    if (!m_changed) {
092      m_changed = true;
093      if (m_supportsChangeNotification) {
094        TunableRegistry.notifyChanged(this);
095      }
096    }
097  }
098
099  /** Resets the changed flag. Should generally only be used by backends. */
100  public void resetChanged() {
101    m_changed = false;
102  }
103}
